summary.zh: 规划 Python 项目的模块划分和公开接口
summary.en: Plan Python module layout and public interfaces

description.zh: 决定目录层级、模块边界和对外暴露的接口，用 __all__ 标明哪些是内部实现。适合新项目起步，或整理日益混乱的代码目录。
description.en: Shapes directory layout, module boundaries, and public interfaces, marking internals with __all__. Use it when starting a project or reorganizing a codebase that has grown messy.
